entities.name: Cats
entities.description: A creature type for felines, domestic and wild, which appear on many planes and include sapient cat-folk.

entities.name: Arahbo
entities.description: The primordial essence of all cats in the Multiverse, from whom all cats are said to descend.

entities.name: Nacatl
entities.description: Leonin of the shard of Naya whose Empire of the Clouds crumbled, leaving isolated tribes.

entities.name: Malamet
entities.description: Jaguarfolk living in Ixalan's underground caverns who fought in the Night War.

entities.name: Maahestet
entities.description: A once-dominant leonin race of Amonkhet reduced to a declining undead cadre led by Zahur.

entities.name: Cat warriors
entities.description: Feline humanoids found throughout Dominaria, mainly Jamuraa, scattered after the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Panther warriors
entities.description: Exiles of the cat warrior nations who took up residence in Urborg.

entities.name: Mirran leonin
entities.description: Honor-based, sun-worshipping leonin of the Razor Fields on Mirrodin, who split into the Kha-Tal and Obu-Tal.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: The god of solidarity, a cat-headed humanoid, to whom cats are sacred.

entities.name: Ketramose
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who appears as a cat-headed humanoid.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet served by serpopards.

entities.name: Zahur
entities.description: Leader of the Maahestet.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A figure to whom the Nayan Sunstrikers pride is loyal.

entities.name: Gydolien Mor
entities.description: The only one of the Numbered Ones to survive the destruction of a Yalomar cat.

entities.name: Purraj
entities.description: A panther warrior leader and ally of Kaervek during the Mirage Wars who possibly perished in Jamuraa.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: A figure allied with Purraj during the Mirage Wars.

entities.name: Marivel
entities.description: Leader of Free Urborg, followers of Lord Windgrace.

entities.name: Kemba
entities.description: A new kha regent supported by the Kha-Tal leonin.

entities.name: Juryan
entities.description: Leader of the Obu-Tal, who called for revolution against old societal structures.

entities.name: Raksha Golden Cub
entities.description: The leonin kha who disappeared, leaving the pride leaderless.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: A being whose defeat on Mirrodin was followed by the Vanishing.

entities.name: Agnomakhos
entities.description: An Archon who tyrannized Meletis and the surrounding lands, supported by Theran leonin.

entities.name: Night War
entities.description: The war on Ixalan in which Malamet, humans and merfolk fought the Coin Empire and the followers of Aclazotz.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion of Dominaria that destroyed the cat warriors' Jamuraan homelands.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane where cats are sacred to Oketra.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane of the Malamet.

events.summary: The Numbered Ones destroy a Yalomar cat with magic, blinding the Khonian midwives and killing all but Gydolien Mor.
events.quote: When the Numbered Ones managed to destroy it with magic, the resulting blast blinded the Khonian midwives and killed all but one of the Numbered Ones, leaving only Gydolien Mor alive.

events.summary: The nacatl's Empire of the Clouds crumbles, reducing them to isolated tribes.
events.quote: Their empire crumbled, and the nacatl were reduced to isolated tribes.

events.summary: After the Conflux, some nacatl migrate to Bant and integrate into its culture.
events.quote: After the Conflux, when Alara was made whole once more, some nacatl migrated to the civilized lands of Bant

events.summary: The Phyrexian Invasion destroys the cat warriors' Jamuraan homelands and scatters their race across Dominaria.
events.quote: After the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria destroyed the cat warriors' Jamuraan homelands, their race was scattered across Dominaria.

events.summary: During the Mirage Wars, panther warriors are led by Purraj, an ally of Kaervek.
events.quote: During the Mirage Wars , they were led by Purraj , an ally of Kaervek

events.summary: The Malamet fight alongside humans and merfolk in the Night War against the Coin Empire and followers of Aclazotz.
events.quote: the Malamet fought alongside the humans and merfolk in the Night War against the Coin Empire and the followers of Aclazotz

events.summary: After Memnarch's defeat and the Vanishing, a schism splits the Mirran leonin.
events.quote: After Memnarch was defeated and the Vanishing sent those leonin abducted from other planes back to where they had come from, a schism ran through the remaining ones.

relations.note: cats are sacred to the god Oketra
relations.quote: Cats, while highly independent creatures, are sacred to Oketra , the god of solidarity.

relations.note: all cats are said to descend from Arahbo
relations.quote: All cats are said to be descended from Arahbo , the primordial essence of all cats in the Multiverse .
During the Mirage Wars , they were led by Purraj , an ally of Kaervek

relations.note: led Free Urborg, defenders of Urborg
relations.quote: Organized in Free Urborg , they were led by Marivel .

relations.note: new kha regent supported by the Kha-Tal
relations.quote: One group of leonin supported a new kha regent Kemba , calling themselves the Kha-Tal.
The other, the Obu-Tal, led by Juryan , called for a revolution against the old societal structures
The kha, Raksha Golden Cub , had disappeared, and the pride was left leaderless.
